Frequently Asked Questions (POD Profit Calc)

What is a healthy profit margin for Print-on-Demand in 2026?

Aim for at least $7–$12 net profit per apparel item (25%–35% net margin before paid ads) so seasonal 15% sales or Etsy Offsite Ads never push an order underwater.

When does upgrading to Printify Premium make financial sense?

Because Printify Premium ($29/mo) discounts blank costs by up to 20% (~$2.00–$3.50 saved per shirt/hoodie), sellers typically break even at just 11 to 14 orders per month.
